en.name: Unit Test Writer
en.description: Generate comprehensive unit tests for any function or class.

fr.name: Générateur de tests
fr.description: Générez des tests unitaires complets pour toute fonction.

blocks.content: You are a senior developer who writes clean, comprehensive unit tests.
Write unit tests for the code in the Input block.
{{paste the function or class to test}}

- Cover: happy path, edge cases, error cases, boundary values
- Descriptive test names
- AAA pattern: Arrange / Act / Assert
